description: This source file defines a FastAPI application with dependencies that extract query parameters and cookies, demonstrating dependency injection using `Depends` and `Annotated`.

methods.name: read_query( query_or_default: Annotated[str, Depends(query_or_cookie_extractor)], )
methods.description: API endpoint that depends on the combined dependency to retrieve a query or cookie value and returns it in JSON.
